Subject: Exec sponsor command + EB rendezvous: MAP & evaluation runbook

Elena / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our QBR cadence and your procurement timeline, I sketched a concise mutual action plan (attached) that aligns the evaluation steps and the close runway. Two things I want to lock down this week: (1) a short Executive Briefing (EB) — 45 minutes with your exec sponsor and the technical evaluation team, and (2) the sponsor mapping so we know who at Stratus will own the final sign-off versus operational onboarding.

Attached: MAP_Stratus_v2.xlsx (contains milestones, owners, acceptance criteria). Highlights:
- Week 1: EB & sponsor alignment (exec + Dir of Cloud Ops)
- Week 2–3: scoped evaluations (latency/cost/obs) with Redwood engineer support
- Week 4: legal/proc review + procurement checklist

Proposed EB windows (Pacific):
- Thu Aug 2 — 09:00–09:45
- Thu Aug 2 — 13:00–13:45
- Fri Aug 3 — 11:00–11:45

Ben and Karthik will own sponsor mapping on our side and will also present the fixed-run checklist for the eval. Monica will coordinate pre-read and any compliance artifacts. Please confirm which of the three windows work for your exec sponsor and who from Stratus should be on the invite (title preferred). If you want a different day, propose one and we’ll adapt.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Laura —

Thanks for sending this through. The MAP looks thorough; a few quick notes from our side:
- Our CIO (Maya Desai) prefers mornings but only Tue/Thu for executive syncs. Thu Aug 2 at 09:00 PT should work pending calendar confirmation.
- Procurement asked that legal see a redline of the MSA and a summary of data residency controls ahead of the EB. Can your legal/ops team provide a short pre-read?
- Rajiv (cc) will handle the technical eval logistics — he suggests a separate deep-dive with your engineers the week after the EB.

We’ll tentatively accept Thu Aug 2, 09:00–09:45 PT. Final invite once procurement/legal confirm.
